mechanism: Split R_CZ into 26 and 806 µm xhigh_po sections and shunt the longer section with 18 pF. Below the nominal 1.9 kHz bypass pole the series length approaches the 832 µm light-load repair. Above the pole the bypass impedance falls toward a 26 µm residual. The lower crossover at 4.7 µF should retain more resistance in the 10–300 µA band. The faster 0.33 µF loop should see less, including at 50 mA. The passive branch uses no switch, bias current source or CL_SNS connection.
